description: Number to words converter, spell out numbers and cheque amounts. Write a number in English words (1234 -> one thousand two hundred and thirty-four), as an ordinal (twenty-first), or as a cheque-style currency amount (one hundred and five dollars and 50/100). Up to quintillions; decimals read digit by digit. Price: $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: number_to_words
